# Binary Search

**Difficulty:** Easy
**Topic:** BinarySearch
**Language:** Java
**LeetCode link:** https://leetcode.com/problems/binary-search/

## Approach

The code implements an iterative binary search algorithm. It maintains `st` and `end` pointers to define the current search space. In each iteration, it calculates the middle index and compares the target with the element at that index, narrowing the search space until the target is found or the space is exhausted.

## Complexity

- Time: O(log n)
- Space: O(1)
